title: VP trial: Analyst stands by ₱1.049B gap in GenCorp reporting

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —Lawyer Alexander Cabrera, a forensic financial analyst, stood by his report on Monday identifying unreported financial transactions involving companies linked to Vice President Sara Duterte and her husband, lawyer Manases Carpio, as a case of “nonreporting” — not “supposed fraud,” as defense lawyer Kristine Ferrer described them. The transactions in question include a ₱1.049-billion gap in GenCorp’s inflows, which Ferrer tackled, along with Metro City Chow Foods Corp. and Cale88 Foods Corp., during her cross-examination of Cabrera on the 38th day of Duterte’s impeachment trial, Cabrera, who had examined financial documents related to the three companies, was testifying in […]...
